evidence.text: Menu | Pizzati Dallas — Pizza, Pasta, Wings, Calzones Menu Catering Contact Order Direct ✦ The Tasting Card · Cedar Springs The menu, in full. — pizza, pasta, calzones, wings, Mediterranean specials Italian classics, a few Levantine pies, the small list of pastas we make in-house. Diet-friendly throughout — vegan and gluten-free options available. Everything we make is 100% pork-free. Order Direct → No fees · Cheapest · Fastest See Order Options DoorDash · Uber Eats · Slice + more Or call 972 · 863 · 8603 Appetizers Pizzas Calzones Pastas Salads Subs Wings Mediterranean Pies Desserts Drinks i . Appetizers Italian starters — bread, cheese, and house meatballs. ii . Pizzas Hand-stretched dough, five sizes, and a topping bench that runs from Akkawi cheese to vegan mozzarella. 100% beef pepperoni and turkey bacon — never any pork. iii . Calzones Folded, sealed, and baked golden. Three sizes (10"/12"/14") — choose a specialty or build your own. iv . Pastas Six pastas, each finished under a blanket of mozzarella and served with a breadstick. Flat $13.95. v . Salads Crisp greens with house dressings. Small comes with one dressing, large with two; extra $0.95. vi . Subs Twelve-inch subs, baked open-faced with mozzarella. Flat $9.95 across the lineup. vii . Wings Jumbo, bone-in, juicy and flavorful — baked, never fried. Pick your sauce; five count tiers from 5 to 20. viii . Mediterranean Pies Our differentiator — Levantine flatbreads baked in the same oven as the pizzas. Akkawi (mild salty melted cheese) and Zaatar (thyme-sumac-sesame in olive oil). ix . Desserts Sweet finishes — Italian classics plus a chocolate mousse cake for the kids (and the rest of us). x . Drinks Cold cans, bottled water, and house-brewed teas. Hand-stretched pies, Levantine specials, diet-friendly, made with love — 100% pork-free. — Open seven nights, until 4 AM Fri & Sat .
